name: Voronoi-Based Foveated Volume Rendering
definition: A foveated volume rendering approach that adapts sampling and reconstruction to human visual acuity fall-off, using gaze tracking to shift a pre-computed sampling mask, reconstructing via Voronoi-based natural neighbor interpolation, and applying temporal smoothing to attenuate peripheral undersampling artifacts.
summary: Voronoi-Based Foveated Volume Rendering adapts sampling to gaze using pre-computed Voronoi masks and natural neighbor interpolation, ensuring symmetric reconstruction to reduce peripheral undersampling artifacts.
